notes.title: January 2025 Update
notes.content:
Hello, players!
This update brings a few quality-of-life features and improvements based on your feedback.

Compact Layout
You can now switch to a compact layout. Perfect if you don't want to be distracted by the animated UI.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/55ec1fa38912916241c93d56052a9ffd717da45b.png

The option is available in the settings.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/7123194eebd0c8a7b40e8c6ae02703084d906313.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/2813441c2341bc5545cda74b18b7a31608af41c6.png

Enhanced Touch Controls
On Steam Deck and touch screen computers, you can now place tents with a single tap. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/fc5414e5d93464a9d28c0cd7dbcb2b73f6b80cfb.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/1c3befa855b49fb50a18058dbf182f95f0559f46.png

Better Hint Contrast
The contrast of certain hints has been improved to make them more readable, especially on larger grids.



Found a bug? Have thoughts on the changes? Share them in the forums!

Happy camping!

notes.title: Layout update
notes.content:
Features

Customize the layout of your grid to match your preferences with this new update!

Grid Placement Options
Move the grid to either the left or right side of the screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/a5b0176f46a210e25be32207123da8dc898b3494.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/ce41c1a52d52576700c647c92f4bd4b9f0dc5512.png

Numbers Placement Options
Choose whether to display the numbers on the left or right side of the grid.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/1588a29aa9dcbebdc106f4376cf20d6607f53d4d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/9a3f2086aed9b067917865f288ee5053abad117e.png

Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug where the pause menu could not be closed if the steam overlay is opened in another game
 Fix a bug where you could place invalid tent-tree links
 Fixed incorrectly unlocking daily hard pack


Have fun!

notes.title: Large Grids Update Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Here's a major update to Tents and Trees, I hope you'll like it!

480 New Levels
24 packs ranging from 13x13 to 20x20 grids
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/b1bc0c6220efd8ba41fa9cc25f3cf0d41a776420.png
New Theme
Relax with this coastal-inspired theme
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/66912a8ddf8aa9942ef05bbf3ef7c827da15bcad.png
11 New Achievements
All related to the new large grids.

Other changes

 Added tabbed UI in the level selection screen
 Star indicator when completing a pack without hints used.
 Tweaks to unlock conditions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/8c4927023e6a3e5c649c44bd5564b7e955a6bdb3.png

Thanks for playing and enjoy the update!

notes.title: Update 1.2 - Steamdeck Update
notes.content:
While Tents and Trees is already "Steamdeck Verified", this update adds better support for the Steamdeck.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/395875b2a009b434e264ce03de96b25c9b260556.png
It especially adds a feature you requested: Touchscreen support!
Touch screen works in the menus and in game.

 Tap once on the grid to place a tent.
 Tap twice to place grass.
 If you tap on a the number in a row/column that has all its tents, it automatically fills the remaining cells with grass.

notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
Fix colors of numbers around the grid not always updating after fast undoes
 Fix Steamdeck rendering quality when playing on other devices as well
 Disable rendering options when running on Steamdeck
 Fix bug with daily packs leaderboards (will take a few days to update the current scores)
 

If you find bugs or have suggestions, please post them in the forums!

Happy camping !

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content: Fix achievements count displayed on the main menu in-game.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - May 2024
notes.content:
Here is the first big update since the release last month.
Thanks for the feedback, and please continue to share your remarks, issues and ideas!

Themes

The Tents and Trees (night) theme is now available immediately, no unlocking required.
When reaching 200 levels, you unlock two Minimalist themes: day and night.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/3065fc04a1f2d405ce61fbdb61caeb9a831eb7a2.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/d713771273a0d2675631356c416f6469095615b8.png

Advanced Controls
Added Advanced Controls options in the settings:

Added an option to show icons when placing tents next to each other (can be disabled, ON by default). Changed the hint displayed when the grid was wrong because of tents next to each other.
Added an option to update numbers around the grid to show the remaining tents while playing (can be disabled, OFF by default)
Added an option to automatically fill grass at the end of level. Previously enabled by default, you can now disable it.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/ace72a516a6f0e8b046f807b0eeb409fcec1f20c.png  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/a634af061934db66545f159b2e5d2ca8fbb96baf.png

notes.title: Last improvements before release
notes.content:
Here is a last patch before the release next week, coming from feedback of recent beta tests.

 Added keyboard support for undo and redo. You can undo a move with "Ctrl+Z" and redo with either "Ctrl+Shift+Z" or "Ctrl+Y"
 Added support of "fullscreen window" (also known as "borderless fullscreen"). This mode is better than standard fullscreen if you are using multiple monitors, or multi-tasking a lot. Available from the settings menu.
 Switching from windowed to fullscreen can now be done using F11 (as well as Alt+Enter).


These changes are available on both the full game and the demo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/253f7684d0787f249d8bb5f44423ef7f5a0ff67b.png
